integrity_notes: The analytic proof covers all positive weights and all allowed sizes. A standalone exact-rational enumerator provides finite corroboration only; no computer-generated finite list is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: All weights strictly positive, a,b >= 2, complete bipartite graphs, Gibbs product-of-weights spanning trees, ordinary degree vectors. Conditional means identify only normalized columns; independence of single pairs not characterized. Independent mathematical review and exhaustive priority verification remain outstanding.
title: Rank-one rigidity of bipartition degree independence in weighted spanning trees
